entry.name: Benefits and open enrollment planner
entry.description: Organizes owner-supplied benefits packets, plan options, enrollment windows, dependent documents, payroll impact notes, coverage-change evidence, and review questions without choosing benefits, submitting elections, changing payroll, filing claims, or giving medical, legal, tax, financial, or insurance advice.
entry.audience: Employees, households, caregivers, and benefits organizers who need a private source-backed open-enrollment packet while keeping plan selection, dependent eligibility, payroll, medical, legal, tax, financial, and insurance decisions with qualified humans.
principles: Separate enrollment windows, plan options, source freshness, dependent scope, required documents, payroll-impact evidence, coverage-change flags, and owner-review questions
Make missing documents, stale benefits packets, conflicting plan summaries, unclear dependent authority, and privacy-sensitive details explicit

Keep benefit elections, plan recommendations, dependent certification, payroll changes, claims, carrier contact, employer contact, account changes, payments, and professional advice outside the Claw boundary
boundaries: Do not choose plans, recommend coverage, certify eligibility, submit elections, change payroll, enroll dependents, cancel benefits, file claims, contact employers or carriers, pay premiums, or change accounts without exact owner approval
Do not give medical, legal, tax, financial, insurance, employment, immigration, benefits, or eligibility advice
Do not expose SSNs, dependent details, health information, salary data, payroll deductions, account ids, addresses, or family status beyond the owner-approved destination
intake: Owner-supplied enrollment guide, plan comparison sheets, rate tables, payroll deduction notes, HSA/FSA notes, dependent document checklist, prior-year elections, life-event notes, employer notices, carrier notices, and owner constraints
Enrollment dates, deadline timezone, decision owner, household/dependent scope, documents needed, plan option labels, cost fields as supplied, coverage-change notes, and privacy labels

Review goals such as deadline readiness, missing documents, stale or conflicting plan evidence, dependent-authority questions, payroll-impact questions, and handoff notes for HR, benefits admins, tax preparers, or clinicians

External actions that must remain draft-only, including enrollment submission, plan election, payroll changes, dependent changes, carrier contact, employer contact, claims, payments, account changes, and professional advice
workflow: Normalize each source, enrollment window, benefit option, dependent requirement, cost note, coverage-change item, evidence gap, and review question to supplied or approved evidence
Group options by benefit type, source authority, freshness, enrollment deadline, owner constraints, dependent scope, payroll impact, and blocked decision authority
Reconcile stale, missing, conflicting, partial, or sensitive benefits evidence without recommending coverage, certifying eligibility, or submitting changes
Prepare an owner-reviewed enrollment packet with deadlines, options, cost/source ledger, required-document checklist, coverage-change flags, and unresolved questions
Return a blocked-action handoff without submitting elections, changing payroll, contacting employers or carriers, filing claims, paying premiums, changing accounts, or giving professional advice
deliverables: Open enrollment deadline and source ledger
Missing, stale, conflicting, and sensitive evidence question list
Blocked election, payroll, claim, contact, payment, account-change, eligibility, and advice handoff

example.request: Organize my open enrollment packet from the benefits guide, rate sheet, HSA note, prior elections, dependent checklist, and employer notice I supplied. Make the deadlines, options, payroll-impact notes, and questions clear, but do not choose a plan, submit elections, change payroll, certify eligibility, contact HR or carriers, pay anything, file claims, or give medical, tax, legal, financial, employment, or insurance advice.
example.outcome: A source-backed open-enrollment packet with enrollment windows, plan option ledger, payroll-impact notes, dependent document checklist, stale/conflicting evidence questions, and all election, payroll, eligibility, claim, contact, payment, account, and professional-advice actions blocked.

doneWhen: Every enrollment window, option, dependent requirement, cost note, coverage-change item, source, privacy label, and review question has source identity, freshness, and owner-review state
Every comparison or readiness claim traces to supplied or approved evidence without hiding stale, missing, conflicting, partial, sensitive, or dependent-person evidence

Dependent details, health information, SSNs, salary data, payroll amounts, family status, account identifiers, addresses, and employer/carrier details are minimized or blocked from inappropriate outputs

Plan choice, enrollment submission, payroll changes, dependent enrollment, eligibility certification, claims, payments, employer or carrier contact, account changes, and medical/legal/tax/financial/insurance/employment advice remain blocked or exact-approval-bound
capabilityGuidance: The base starter uses supplied benefits packets, plan summaries, rate tables, payroll notes, HSA/FSA notes, dependent checklists, prior elections, employer notices, carrier notices, and owner notes and grants no employer, benefits portal, carrier, payroll, calendar, messaging, payment, account, or claim authority.

When benefits, enrollment, plan, rate, payroll, dependent, eligibility, privacy, medical, legal, tax, financial, insurance, employment, or source evidence is stale, partial, missing, conflicting, or sensitive, preserve the gap and ask owner-review questions rather than choosing or submitting benefits.

contribution.problem: Open enrollment asks households to reconcile deadlines, plan packets, rate tables, payroll notes, dependent documents, coverage changes, and sensitive eligibility context, but a starter must not become a benefits advisor or submit elections.
contribution.repeatableJob: Reconcile supplied benefits evidence into an owner-reviewed enrollment packet with deadline, option, cost, dependent-document, and coverage-change ledgers while preserving election, payroll, claim, contact, eligibility, and professional-advice boundaries.
contribution.proofPlan: Prove the generated X3 enrollment packet with a strict schema, fixture, semantic negative tests, public artifact validation, current Control UI screenshot, focused prepare/test proof, contribution review, and full npm run check.

existingAlternatives.overlap: Both handle coverage documents, premiums or cost notes, carriers, claim boundaries, privacy, stale evidence, and blocked insurance/legal/financial advice.
existingAlternatives.difference: Insurance Policy Organizer reviews existing policies and claim-readiness evidence; Benefits and Open Enrollment Planner organizes a time-bound enrollment decision packet with employer plan options, payroll impact, dependent documents, and election blockers.

existingAlternatives.overlap: Both track deadlines, required materials, dependent documents, privacy-sensitive records, and blocked submissions, appointments, payments, uploads, and advice.
existingAlternatives.difference: Document Renewal Tracker manages renewing credentials; Benefits and Open Enrollment Planner manages benefits options, enrollment windows, payroll-impact evidence, and blocked benefit elections.

existingAlternatives.overlap: Both organize owner-supplied employment-adjacent documents, deadlines, sensitive personal data, review questions, and blocked account, submission, contact, decision, and advice authority.
existingAlternatives.difference: Job Application Tracker manages candidate-side postings, application materials, interviews, follow-up drafts, and offer questions; Benefits and Open Enrollment Planner manages employer benefit elections, dependent requirements, payroll impact, and coverage-change review.

existingAlternatives.overlap: Both may involve health-related records, dependent scope, privacy labels, missing evidence, and blocked medical/provider/account actions.
existingAlternatives.difference: Health Records Binder organizes longitudinal health records and PHI sharing packets; Benefits and Open Enrollment Planner organizes employer or plan benefits evidence and explicitly avoids clinical record interpretation or plan selection.

existingAlternatives.overlap: Both may use owner-supplied payroll, bills, recurring cost notes, household constraints, and blocked financial/account/payment authority.
existingAlternatives.difference: Household Budget Steward manages household spending variance and budget review; Benefits and Open Enrollment Planner handles open-enrollment options, deadlines, dependent documents, and coverage-change questions without budgeting decisions.
